title: Paper links
summary: Search 16,431 links to papers, lecture notes, slides, books and talks by title, note, site or tag, filter them by field, arXiv class, topic, form, source and site, and export BibTeX for the links you tick or for every link that matches. The search, the filters, the ranking, the selection and the BibTeX run in Rust compiled to WebAssembly, with the same matches, order, citation keys and escaping as the Paper Links page of the old site, and TeX in the notes shows as MathML. The page is a sealed artifact: the Links page of yujieteo/site (teoyujie.org/notes/links/) embeds it, and the site pins its bytes. The data (links.json) is the 16,431 records of data/paper-links/paper-links.yaml in yujieteo/sitedumb at commit 8a823b9bd4007b3116d21c12593f227baed2a806, converted once to JSON with no record dropped or changed; the page carries it compressed and fetches nothing.
checks: cargo build --locked --release -q --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p links --lib && cargo run --locked --release -q -p links --bin page -- ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/links.wasm ../../target/links.html && cmp ../../target/links.html index.html
